nodes.rationale: Groq only describes backend-computed metrics and never calculates or changes quantities, prices, totals or statuses; failures return metrics with summaryStatus unavailable.

nodes.label: Seller QR scanner (expo-camera) for order handover

nodes.label: Compounding 12-hour price reduction with minimum price floor
